items.title: John "Knocky" Parker Interview, 1963-08-28
items.q: I thought it was Tom something. I don't think it's a shame person. I don't know.

ctx.x: Well, the name I thought last night was Fincher. But he was around Asheville that he promoted the Crazy Water Crystals. But I never associated him with Mineral Wells.

I thought it was Tom something. I don't think it's a shame person. I don't know. Somebody who had stock or owned stock in Mineral Wells with Crazy Water Crystals in Mineral Wells, Texas. That's where the company first started and had its home office.
It could be that the company had an eastern representative in Asheville who was Fincher, and then someone else did its Texas work.
